outline: The player (Coach) provides a passing option for a pressured Teammate by moving to an open position on the field. After reaching position, the Coach waits to receive the ball from the Teammate. Upon gaining possession, the Coach observes the Opponent's defensive action. If the Opponent pressures the Coach, the Coach passes the ball back to the Teammate. If the Opponent decides to stay with the Teammate (not pressuring the Coach), the Coach shoots for the Goal.

target.info: Coach moves to an open position on either the left or right side of the field to create a clear passing lane for the Teammate, who is currently being pressured by an Opponent.
